data.one_liner: Core library for the Stac server‑driven UI framework, providing models, interfaces, and utilities.
data.what_it_does: It defines the core data models, interfaces, and common utilities that other Stac packages depend on. The package is pure Dart and works across all Flutter platforms.
use_when: Extending Stac with custom widgets or models
Creating a new Stac package that needs the core interfaces
avoid_when: You are not using the Stac framework
You need a full widget set or UI kit
strengths: Provides a single source of truth for Stac models
Pure Dart – no native platform code
weaknesses: No UI widgets or visual components
Only useful when paired with other Stac packages
